meta.title: DroidDeck: PC gaming on Android
meta.desc: DroidDeck brings the SteamOS experience to Android: Steam Gaming Mode, a full Linux desktop, and your games from GOG, Epic, Xbox, Battle.net and more. Free and open source.
hero.kicker: Free and open source. No root.
hero.title: Your Steam library runs on Android now.
hero.sub: DroidDeck brings the SteamOS experience to handhelds and phones: Gaming Mode, a full Linux desktop, and your games from GOG, Epic, Xbox, Battle.net and more in one library.
hero.caption: Steam Big Picture, then Switch to Desktop.

features.title: Features
f.steam.title: The real Steam client
f.steam.body: Big Picture, Steam Input, cloud saves, achievements and Remote Play, with your Windows games running through Proton.
f.stores.title: One library for every store
f.stores.body: Sign in to each store once. Its games sit next to your Steam ones.
f.desktop.title: A full Linux desktop
f.desktop.body: Pick Switch to Desktop and you land in KDE Plasma, with Firefox, a terminal and an app store.
f.hud.title: Performance HUD
f.hud.body: FPS, frame times, temperatures and battery, in a corner or docked.
f.multi.title: Local multiplayer
f.multi.body: Pair a few controllers and play split screen on one device.
f.vr.title: SteamVR
f.vr.body: Play VR on a Quest, or with Joy-Con and camera hand tracking.
f.cloud.title: Xbox Cloud Gaming
f.cloud.body: Stream Game Pass without leaving the launcher.
f.dual.title: Dual screens
f.dual.body: The second screen becomes a keyboard, a trackpad or a dashboard.
f.themes.title: Themes
f.themes.body: Recolour the launcher, or mix your own gradient.
also.title: More features
also.glasses: Head tracking for VITURE, RayNeo, XREAL 1S and Rokid glasses
also.lsfg: LSFG frame generation, if you own Lossless Scaling
also.flatpak: Linux apps and emulators from Flathub
also.storage: Games on an SD card or a USB drive
also.apps: Your Android apps and widgets in the launcher
also.pads: Controller profiles and stick dead zones
compat.title: Games people are playing
compat.sub: Reports from the community, on their own devices. Your results depend on your chip and your settings.
devices.title: What it runs on
devices.sub: Android 9 or newer. No root needed.
gpu.yes.body: Adreno 730 and newer, and every Adreno 8xx
guide.title: Set up in four steps
g1.title: Check your device
g1.body: You need Android 9 or newer and about 3 GB free. Add 1.1 GB for the desktop and emulators.
g2.title: Install the APK
g2.body: Download it from GitHub Releases and open it. Android asks you to allow the install.
g3.title: Install the Linux runtime
g3.body: DroidDeck downloads it the first time you open it. Stay on Wi-Fi.
g4.title: Press Play and sign in
g4.body: Steam opens in Gaming Mode. Sign in, then install a game.
tip.title: On Android 14 or newer?
tip.body: Turn on "Disable child process restrictions" in Developer options. On Android 12 and 13, Steam's first launch shows a "Fix it for me" button.
help.title: Stuck?
help.body: Ask on Discord. For bugs, post in #bug-reports with the zip from Share logs.
official.bar: droid-deck.dev is the only official DroidDeck website.
official.title: Watch out for fake sites
official.body: Copycat websites are using the DroidDeck name, and some get a lot of visitors. None of them are ours. Don't download anything from them.
official.c3: DroidDeck is free. We never ask for payment, a sign-up or a survey.
official.report: Report a fake site to Google

download.preview: Want fixes early? Preview builds are in the app under Updates > Preview.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.a1: Yes. It is free and open source under GPL-3.0, with no ads and no telemetry.
faq.a2: Anything on Android 9 or newer. It runs best on Adreno 730 and newer. Mali, Xclipse, PowerVR and older Adreno chips are experimental.
faq.a3: No. On Android 14 or newer you flip one switch in Developer options. The setup guide shows which one.
faq.q4: Does it work on Mali, Exynos or MediaTek?
faq.a4: It starts on many of them, but support is experimental. Some games crash or show a black screen. Fixes reach Preview builds first.
faq.q5: Is it on the Play Store?
faq.a5: Not today. Get the APK from GitHub Releases. Android may warn you about installing outside the store, which is normal.
faq.q7: Is it safe to sign in to Steam?
faq.a7: You sign in inside the real Steam client, the same one a Steam Deck runs. All of DroidDeck's code is public.
faq.q8: Do online games with anti-cheat work?
faq.a8: Mostly not. Games that need kernel anti-cheat will not go online. Some Easy Anti-Cheat games can still be played offline.
faq.q9: My game runs slowly. What can I try?
faq.a9: Lower the in-game settings first, then try a newer graphics driver in DroidDeck's settings. The performance HUD shows what is holding the game back.
faq.q10: Can I install games on an SD card?
faq.a10: Yes. Set External storage as the default under Setup > Storage, then install. Games you already have stay where they are.
faq.a11: Yes. Built-in controls, Bluetooth and USB pads all work, and you can pair several for split screen. There are touch controls too.
faq.q12: How do I get fixes early or report a bug?
faq.a12: Preview builds are in the app under Updates > Preview. For bugs, post in #bug-reports with the zip from Share logs.
